claims.citation: New York Herald, 4 June 1866, p. 5, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Hermann (Brem), Wenke, Bremen May 20, via
Southampton 23d, at 4 PM, with mdse and 724 passengers,
to Oelrichs & Co. May 21, off Dover, spoke ship Adler
(Brem), from New York for London; also ships Magdalene
(Brem), and Meridian (Brem), from Bremen for New York;
24th, at 9 AM, lat 49 45, lon 7 20, passed steamship Borussia,
for Cowes; 25th, lat 50, lon 17, ship Mobile (Brem), from
Bremen for New York; 28th, lat 50, lon 25, passed a National
Company's steamer bound E; June 1, lat 41, lon 64, steam-
ship Tripoli, hence for Liverpool; also bark Industrie (Brem),
steering W; 2d, off Nantucket, ship Portenia, steering W.
